## Общая часть каждого вызова

Use case: style-transfer. Create an art-only landscape illustration for a real travel-memory photodiary, aspect ratio 3:2. Input image is the owner's actual photo of Mir Castle in Belarus, used as the exact architectural and viewpoint reference. Preserve the same distinctive red-brick and white plaster towers, roof silhouettes, walls, relative proportions, perspective and courtyard. Do not turn it into a generic European castle. Preserve the object identity faithfully. Output only the illustration, no page mockup, no typography, no QR codes, no labels or watermark.

## 1. Графика

Style: elegant BLACK AND WHITE architectural pen-and-ink engraving, hand-drawn fine lines, controlled crosshatching, ample white paper negative space. Restrained, crisp, sophisticated adult travel journal, pure black ink and white, no gray photographic overlay. Recognisable architecture, lovely printable line work.

## 2. Акварель

Style: luminous traditional WATERCOLOR on warm white cotton paper. Transparent loose washes, delicate precise architectural line accents, subtle bleeding edges, soft sage greens and muted terracotta brick, grey-blue sky. Mature art travel journal; charming, light, spacious. Preserve landmark architecture, not a cartoon.

## 3. Фотография

Использован mir-author-photo.webp. Погода, здание и содержимое снимка не изменялись. В PDF выполнено только пропорциональное размещение изображения.

## 4. Фэнтези

Style: tasteful FANTASY travel-journal illustration, painterly magical realism. Mir Castle remains clearly recognisable with the same existing towers and perspective. Warm golden window glows, soft enchanted indigo twilight, restrained tiny firefly lights and a dreamy pale sky. Rich but elegant colours. No extra towers, no dragons, people, invented landmarks, or changes to actual architectural massing. This is visibly an artistic fantasy interpretation, not documentary photography.

## Сборка

Текст и QR собраны отдельно от растрового изображения через ReportLab в настоящие A5-страницы. PDF содержит четыре варианта первой страницы и две общие страницы: место под фото 102×152 мм и дневник без линеек. Это образец для согласования, а не выпущенная книга.
